Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, recolour, bind to Glamourer designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Reshape any mod's models. Paint on your character to pull clothing clear of your body, push it in, smooth it, stretch it across a hollow, or paint where the wind sways it. Hair works too. Edits save into the mod and can be undone.

• Add on/off switches to any part of any mod.

• Make modded hair fit under hats, and undo it any time.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Save a mod's look as a preset you can wear, share and swap.

• Imports Penumbra .pmp, Onion .omp and Atramentum Luminis .ttmp2 glow tattoos, with no shader mod needed.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Punchline: Overlays, off-slot gear and model editing for Penumbra mods
Changelog:
Refit gear for the other sex, women's overlays on men, and Move skin too

Body size: men and women
- "Refit for" now crosses the sexes for Midlander gear: men's tops and legs can be made women's, and women's tops
  and legs men's.
- Women's garments rigged to YAS (or another women's skeleton) can be made men's. Their extra bones are moved onto
  the men's skeleton (IVCS when you have it), and the moves are listed for you.
- Men's legs refitted for women move TBSE's earring bones onto the hips, so the pants no longer follow the ears.
- "Every size for other bodies" offers TBSE and TBSE-X on a women's mod, adding men's versions of its chest and
  legs in a group of their own, "Men's body".
- "Refit for" also goes down a race: a Highlander-only garment can be made a Midlander's.
- Nothing is refused for folded faces any more. How many turned over is shown in the warning colour, so you can
  check those spots in game.

Body size: fit
- Refit onto a body option that models underwear in place of skin (Muse+'s and Bibo+'s SFW options): the underwear
  comes in with the garment.
- Panties, thongs and leotards refitted onto another body no longer pull apart at the crotch when the legs spread.
- A refit swaps the old body's waist skin even where it runs past the new body's legs.
- A refit from the game's own chest follows a flatter chest, its bra read together with its skin.
- The Body size tool refits the game's own tops the same way the automatic refit does.
- The game's own tops refitted onto a large bust (such as the Witch's Coatee) no longer show their inside through
  open skin at the strap tips.
- Keep shape no longer throws flat pieces far off the body (Virtu Dancer's giant buttons on Tre). A refit that
  already came out wrong needs remaking.

Overlays on men
- Women's Proteus overlays and tattoos now show on men (TBSE or the men's vanilla body), moved into his layout
  through body maps that download the first time they're needed.
- "Overlay on men" (on by default) turns that on or off per mod. Art made for men is never changed.

Studio
- "Move skin too" lets the brushes, Grab, Move, Rotate and Scale reshape the garment's own body skin, with the
  clothes over it following.
- Mirror left/right now works for Move, Rotate and Scale too, and mirrors skin moved with "Move skin too".
- The game's own gear opens as itself, and is only copied into a mod when you first change it, not when you
  click it.
- Live brush previews are written as temporary files, so brushing writes far less to disk.

Colours
- Dragging a colour, glow or other colour-table control saves the mod's settings once, when you let go, instead
  of on every frame. The character still follows the drag live.

Hair
- Settings > Hair: "Take the ears off Miqo'te hair mods" makes earless copies of eared Miqo'te hair mods; turning
  it off brings the ears back.
- Miqo'te hair with ears now ports to Lalafell (Loosened Bun, and the game's hairstyles 194 and 195).
- Hair ports read the source hair's skeleton entry from the mod's other groups too.
- Hair that folds when fitted to another race is fitted with a warning instead of refused.

Mods
- A Proteus mod renamed in Penumbra is followed instead of dropping out of Proteus.

Please say if anything looks wrong.

Author: Solona
Name: Camera Tools
Description:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Punchline: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.
